```{r}
ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/3260758/files/ligand_target_matrix.rds"))

```

```{r}
ligands = p$data$interaction %>% str_split(pattern = " -> ", simplify = T) %>% .[,1] %>% unique()

```

```{r}
background_expressed_genes  <- get_expressed_genes("Myo", acc_cancer_immune_caf, pct = 0.05) %>% .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]

```


```{r}
DE_table_receiver <-  FindMarkers(
  object = acc_cancer_immune_caf[1:100],
  ident.1 = "Luminal",
  ident.2 = "Myo",
  group.by = "cell_type",
  min.pct = 0.05
) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
```

```{r}
geneset_oi <- DE_table_receiver %>% filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene)
geneset_oi <- geneset_oi %>% .[. %in% rownames(ligand_target_matrix)]
```

```{r}
nichenet_activities <- predict_ligand_activities(
  geneset = geneset_oi,
  background_expressed_genes = background_expressed_genes,
  ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, potential_ligands = ligands
)
```
